paite: Upa in, tel a om numei leh atate thutak a ka it, kei kia hilou a, thutak thei peuhmahte kiang ah;
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: thutak eimah a om gige, tangtawn a i kiang ua om gige ding ahih ziak in;
Pa Pathian a kipan leh Pa' Tapa, Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna, leh khamuanna in thutak leh itna ah noute hon ompih hen.
Pa kiang a kipan athupiak i muh bang in na ta kuate hiam thutak a om a ka muh ziak in ka kipak mahmah hi.
heading: Khrist Thupiak Zuihna

paite: Numei hoih, na kiang a thupiak thak gelh hilou in, atung a kipan a i neih pen gelh zaw in, i ki-ittuah theihna ding in nget petmah in ka hon ngen hi.
Huan hiai itna ahi, athupiak bang zel a i omna uh. Hiai ahi thupiak atung a kipat ana zak uh, huai ah na om ding uh ahi.
Jesu Khrist taksa in ahong pai chih gum lou khemmi tampi khovel ah ahong pawtta uhi. Huai mite ahi, khemmi leh Khrist doumi.
I sepkhiaksate mangsak lou a, akipahman bukim a i muhtheihna ding un, nangmah kivenghoih in.
Kuapeuh huai Khrist thu sinsakna thu a om gige lou a talek in Pathian anei kei. Huai thu sinsakna thu a a-om gige in Pa leh Tapa aneikhawm hi.
Kuapeuh huai thu sinsakna thu hon po lou a, na kiang ua ahong paileh na inn uah tungsak kei unla, paukam hoih in kha sam kei un,
paukam hoih a kha peuhmah athilhihkhelh ah panna anei ngal a.
Na kiang ua thu tampi gen ding ka neih ziak in lai leh laitui a gelh ka ut kei a; na kipahna uh akimtheihna ding in na kiang ua hong hoh a, kimaituah a kihou ka lamen zaw hi.
heading: Thu Nanungte

paite: Na sanggamnu tel tate un chibai ahon buk uhi, Amen.
